name: metric-list
summary: The DS metric / KPI list (obs-metric-list) — the product's vertical-value-grid. Each row is a PROMINENT value (a large number + a unit, right-aligned) followed by its label; no column header. Used by dashboard metric / KPI widgets. NOT a data table (it only shares the grid chrome) — for rows-of-records use obs-table.
element_note: Split out of the Storybook Table 'vertical-value' variant — it's a metric LAYOUT, not a data table.

variants.name: color-coded
variants.what: [element] a threshold-coloured value — an optional 4th item field / `color` key is a --severity token (the product ColorCodedCell colouring), e.g. --severity-critical → the value renders red

items.note: [[value, unit, label], …] or [[value, unit, label, color], …] or [{value, unit, label, color?}] — JSON string or a JS array. `color` is a --severity token (e.g. "--severity-critical") that colours the value (the product ColorCodedCell threshold colouring).

decisionFlow: Showing a few prominent metrics/KPIs (a big number + unit + label each)? -> Metric List.
Rows of records with columns? -> the Table (obs-table).
Label→value pairs describing ONE record? -> Key-Value (obs-key-value).
do: Use for dashboard KPI / metric widgets (availability, throughput, latency).
Give each item a value + unit + label.
Colour a threshold value with a --severity token (the item's 4th field / `color` key), never a hex.
dont: Don't use for tabular records (use obs-table).
Don't use for a record's key/value detail (use obs-key-value).

metric-list.useWhen: a small set of headline metrics/KPIs, each a big value + unit + label
metric-list.dontUse: for tabular records (obs-table) or key/value record detail (obs-key-value)
metric-list.example: a dashboard widget: 99.98% Availability, 1.2 k/s Requests, 142 ms p95 latency

color-coded.useWhen: a metric's value should signal severity/threshold state (over budget, critical, healthy) — pass an optional `color` (a --severity token) as the 4th item field or object key
color-coded.dontUse: don't hardcode a hex — always a --severity token; don't colour a value that has no threshold meaning
color-coded.example: CPU 94% in --severity-critical (red), Memory 61% in --severity-warning, Disk 12% in --severity-clear (green)

a11y.summary: A borderless table of value/label rows; ensure the value+unit reads as one figure. Consider a <dl> if it's semantically key/value.

knownIssues: [element] obs-metric-list is FUNCTIONAL: pass items ([value,unit,label] tuples/objects). Split from the Storybook Table 'vertical-value' variant since it's a metric layout, not a data table.
changelog: 2026-07-13: color-coded values + playground (owner) — an optional `color` (a --severity token) on an item colours the value (the product ColorCodedCell threshold colouring; e.g. --severity-critical → red). Added the Details-tab dataset playground (KPIs / color-coded / utilization presets) and gallery examples (tuples, color-coded, objects). Documented the full surface in the new prose spec.

2026-07-13: row hover (owner) — added a real row-hover highlight (`tr:hover td` → --neutral-lighter, 0.12s ease). Earlier this was wrongly dismissed as an Inspect-mode artifact; the owner wanted an actual hover affordance, matching the product list-row convention.

2026-07-13: width fix (owner) — the playground was shrink-wrapping the widget to ~208px (labels wrapped); changed :host to display:block, widened the max-width, and gave the element full stage width so labels/values sit on one line.
2026-07-13: shipped <obs-metric-list> — the DS metric/KPI list (vertical-value-grid). Split out of the Storybook Table variant set (it's a metric LAYOUT, not a table).
